approval_evidence: Perfect this is good. Now keep this as a reference point, we will only improve from here with new idea and projects.

defaults.presenter: current Emirati presenter in white kandura; replaceable by explicit creative revision
defaults.timing: measured narration; do not rush the full script to fit a nominal duration

quality_rules: Every important sentence changes the explanatory diagram meaningfully; captions and presenter pose changes alone do not qualify.
Stable object identities carry cause, action and consequence across scenes.
Use deterministic SVG/canvas for exact text, charts, labels, counters and continuity-critical objects.
Use generated presenter masters, illustrations and textures selectively; they must not carry exact quantities or readable text.
Charts and counters read the same source values; distinguish differing periods, denominators and samples.
Synchronize motion, captions and purposeful SFX to measured narration.
Render reproducibly from local assets, fonts, claim ledger and JSON manifests, then run content, continuity, readability and technical QC.
A new topic requires its own visual review against this reference; do not copy a fixed scene count or claim the hard-coded example is universal.
